sn35.13:1.2: pubbeva me bhikkhave, sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattasseva sato etadahosi.
sn35.13:1.3: ko nu kho cakkhussa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.13:1.8: ko manassa assādo, ko ādīnavo, kiṃ nissaraṇanti.
sn35.13:1.10: yaṃ kho cakkhuṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ cakkhussa assādo.
sn35.13:1.11: yaṃ cakkhuṃ aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ vipariṇāmadhammaṃ, ayaṃ cakkhussa ādīnavo.
sn35.13:1.12: yo cakkhusmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ cakkhussa nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.13:1.15: yaṃ jivhaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ jivhāya assādo.
sn35.13:1.16: yā jivhā aniccā dukkhā vipariṇāmadhammā, ayaṃ jivhāya ādīnavo.
sn35.13:1.17: yo jivhāya chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ jivhāya nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.13:1.19: yaṃ manaṃ paṭicca uppajjati sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, ayaṃ manassa assādo.
sn35.13:1.20: yo mano anicco dukkho vipariṇāmadhammo, ayaṃ manassa ādīnavo.
sn35.13:1.21: yo manasmiṃ chandarāgavinayo chandarāgappahānaṃ, idaṃ manassa nissaraṇaṃ.
sn35.13:2.1: yāvakīvañcāhaṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ channaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato, ādīnavañca ādīnavato, nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ nābbhaññāsiṃ, neva tāvāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn35.13:2.2: yato ca kho’haṃ bhikkhave, imesaṃ channaṃ ajjhattikānaṃ āyatanānaṃ evaṃ assādañca assādato, ādīnavañca ādīnavato, nissaraṇañca nissaraṇato yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ, athāhaṃ bhikkhave, sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya anuttaraṃ sammāsambodhiṃ abhisambuddhoti paccaññāsiṃ.
sn35.13:2.4: akuppā me cetovimutti ayamantimā jāti, natthidāni punabbhavoti.
